Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Defense is the best defense with this Sandevistan model by QianT. It utilizes cutting-edge defensive protocols to ensure the best possible response to continuous enemy attacks.

Sandevistan Operating System. The Sandevistan can now be activated as half of a ROF 2 Action, and its duration is reduced to 12 seconds (4 Rounds).

While active, along with gaining Sandevistan’s usual +3 bonus to Initiative, the user may perform any of the following Actions as half of a ROF 2 Action: Equip/Drop Shield, Get Up, Reload, Stabilize (yourself only), and any Action taken to activate an item or cyberware, clear a jam, put yourself out while On Fire, or stow a weapon. None of these ROF 2 Actions can be taken twice in one Turn.

After the Sandevistan’s duration ends, it cannot be activated again for an hour unless the user voluntarily suffers 2 Humanity Loss per consecutive activation before an hour passes (e.g., 2 -> 4 -> 6, etc).

Enhances: Sandevistan
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Foundry notes:

  • Every Operating System is incompatible with every other Operating System and with the base cyberware it is for: none of them can be installed while another OS, or that OS's own base cyberware, is anywhere in the user's body or in a worn apparatus they're connected to. The sheet doesn't enforce that.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Sandevistan Operating Systems).
